headline: Sakellaridis on the National Price Reduction Initiative: Government mockery and business greed - Dnews
summary: Gavriil Sakellaridis says some products included in the National Price Reduction Initiative have risen, so their reduced prices now exceed July levels. He cites Eurostat's August inflation data.
why: Consumer price controls and inflation data shape household spending, retail margins and expectations for Greek monetary and fiscal policy.
